title: APNG Cut-in
description: Full-screen cut-ins (APNG, GIF, WebP or WebM, with optional sound), launched by the GM and shown to every player. Can also play an animation on a roll result (critical success, failure…), shown only to the player who rolled. Roll-result animations are preloaded at login, and an APNG with a WebM of the same name next to it plays as that much lighter WebM (Safari and iOS keep the APNG).
